Subject: Discovery recap + next steps

Hi Jordan / Elena —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned before the demo: 

- Primary objective: evaluate Redwood for low-latency inference of clinical note summarization and embeddings for search.
- Key success metrics: P95 latency under 350ms for single-turn queries; embedding throughput 500/s with <2¢ per embedding unit.
- Data constraints: PHI stays in-house; NovaHealth prefers Private deployment (VPC) or dedicated capacity.
- Stakeholders to include on the technical demo: Engineering (CTO), Data Science, and Security (infosec) — initial list below.

Suggested next step: 60-minute technical demo + architecture Q&A where Marcus (our SE) can walk through runtime, security controls, and quantization tradeoffs. Can you confirm who will attend and which of these three slots works for you?

- Tue 25 May — 14:00 ET / 11:00 PT (60m)
- Wed 26 May — 10:00 ET / 07:00 PT (60m)
- Thu 27 May — 16:30 ET / 13:30 PT (60m)

If none of these fit, send a couple of windows and I’ll route a calendar invite. Once you confirm attendees, I’ll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and a short agenda. Also attaching our one-pager on expected throughput and a template mutual action plan that might speed procurement.

Thanks,
